name: AI X-ray scientist
one_line: LLM agent with MCP tools and SPEC commands aligned a single crystal on SSRL BL17-2; developed in a virtual diffractometer; human relayed commands.

name: VISION
one_line: Modular LLM assistant turning voice/text into Bluesky code at NSLS-II 11-BM; first voice-controlled X-ray scattering experiment.

name: CALMS
one_line: Retrieval- and tool-augmented LLM answering facility-documentation questions and conversationally operating instruments.

name: Instrument agents that learn on the job
one_line: Human-in-the-loop LLM agents orchestrating an X-ray nanoprobe beamline and an autonomous robotic materials station, improving through iterative feedback.

name: Experiment Automation Agents (EAA)
one_line: Vision-language agents with MCP tools automate zone-plate focusing and natural-language feature search at an APS imaging beamline.

name: ALD reactor agent
one_line: LLM agent converts user queries into JSON-encoded atomic layer deposition processes executed on a real reactor through an MCP-compatible interface.

name: ALS accelerator agentic AI
one_line: Plan-first agent ran multistage machine-physics experiments on the ALS accelerator; preparation time cut ~100x under operator safety constraints.

name: Osprey
one_line: Control-room agent framework with human plan review before hardware actions; production deployment across hundreds of thousands of ALS control channels.

name: Lightfall
one_line: API-first beamline control platform with embedded LLM agent and staff-authored skills; in testing at ALS COSMIC-Scattering.

name: TEM Agent
one_line: MCP tools let a commercial LLM control TEM subsystems, data management and HPC through text instructions, without extra training.

name: A-Lab GPSS agentic reasoning
one_line: Agentic AI proposed 352 air-free solid-state syntheses of halide spinel conductors; success fraction rose from 1.33% to 5.33%.

name: LLM-assisted scanning probe microscopy
one_line: GPT-4 with instrument APIs converts experimental workflow ideas into microscope code; limited for in-depth experimental design.

name: NSLS-II multi-beamline AI agents
one_line: Non-LLM agents inside Bluesky run on-the-fly reduction, GP modeling and Bayesian-optimized XRD/XAFS mapping across two beamlines.

name: NeuDiff Agent
one_line: Governed agent takes single-crystal neutron data to validated CIF with allowlisted tools and fail-closed gates; 4.6-5.0x faster than manual.

name: SasAgent
one_line: Coordinator plus three specialist LLM agents use SasView tools for SLD calculation, synthetic data and small-angle scattering fitting.

name: EQSANS-CLI
one_line: Agent-addressable SANS reduction tool; an external agent with one skill document drives complete reductions through a Slack bot.

name: APEXA
one_line: Deployed 61-tool multi-agent calibration and integration system; guard refuses results not backed by executed tool calls.

name: PEAR
one_line: Multiple LLM agents handle ptychography knowledge retrieval, code generation, parameter recommendation and image reasoning.

name: ESAC
one_line: Retrieval-augmented chatbot serving as an interactive instrument reference for visiting EQ-SANS users.

name: APS-RAG
one_line: Deployed agentic GraphRAG over logbooks, documents, wikis and control data for APS staff; 70.3% vs 63.8% strict recall.

name: ChatEED
one_line: Agentic retrieval assistant over electronic logbooks and wikis for accelerator operators.

name: LLM proposal ranking
one_line: Pairwise LLM ranking of proposals from three SNS beamlines correlates with human rankings (Spearman 0.2-0.8) at over 100x lower cost.

name: LLM accelerator tuning
one_line: LLM tunes an accelerator subsystem from an operator's natural-language prompt, benchmarked against Bayesian optimization and RL-trained optimizers.

name: GAIA
one_line: ReAct-style LLM assistant combining logbook and document retrieval with control-script generation for accelerator operations.

name: Rongzai agent
one_line: LLM plus GSAS-II agent performs neutron Rietveld refinement from natural-language task to report; deployed at CSNS for external users.
